name: Acholi
text: Lobo onoŋo tye nono, onyobbe woko atata piny macol ocido wi kut matut, kun Cwiny pa Lubaŋa twago wi pii.
normalised_text: lobo onongo tye nono, onyobbe woko atata piny machol ochido wi kut matut, kun chwiny pa lubanga twago wi pii.

name: Adioukrou
text: Jesu Krist lagŋɛl Abraham ɛm, lele David ɛm ab e mew.
normalised_text: jesu krist lagngel abraham em, lele david em ab e mew.

name: Afrikaans
text: Alles het begin toe God die hemel en die aarde gemaak het.
normalised_text: alles het begin toe god die hemel eng die aarde khemaak het.

name: Alur
text: Man ngom ubedo umbe ayi man mananu; man mudho bedo wi wang longro: e Tipo pa Mungu riebre wi wang pi.
normalised_text: man ngom ubedo umbe ayi man mananu; man mudo bedo wi wang longro e tipo pa mungu riebre wi wang pi.

name: Amharic
text: ምድር ግን ባዶ ነበ​ረች፤ አት​ታ​ይ​ምም ነበር፤ የተ​ዘ​ጋ​ጀ​ችም አል​ነ​በ​ረ​ችም፤ ጨለ​ማም በው​ኃው ላይ ነበረ፤ የእ​ግ​ዚ​አ​ብ​ሔ​ርም መን​ፈስ በው​ኃው ላይ ይሰ​ፍፍ ነበር።.
normalised_text: mudiri ginu bado neberechi etitayimumu neberi yetezegajechimu eluneberechimu chelemamu bewihawi layi nebere yeigiziebiherimu menufesi bewihawi layi yisefifi neberi.

name: Anyin
text: Ɛ 'nwun Zozi Kilisi anan-mɔ dunman'n, ɔ bɔ yɩ́ bʋ *Abalahamʋn ɛlɔ dede ɔ sɩn belemgbin *Davidi ɛlɔ nán ɔ'a tʋ Zozi.
normalised_text: e nwun zozi kilisi ananmo dunmann, o bo yi bu abalahamun elo dede o sin belemgbin davidi elo nan oa tu zozi.
